name: PreferImg-Bench
description: PreferImg-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating image preference and ranking behavior of models when presented with multiple image options. It measures a model's ability to predict human-like preferences or select the preferred image among alternatives given a prompt or context. The benchmark is intended to assess alignment of image models to human judgments and preference ranking performance.
reputation: Relatively new and niche dataset with limited but growing use for image preference and alignment research.
